problem:
Consider the affine transformation $T,$ defined as

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 3 & -1\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}

What is the area scale factor of the transformation?

activity_context.topic_title: The Image of an Affine Transformation

feedback.problem:
Consider the affine transformation $T,$ defined as

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 \\ -2 & -3\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

 

What is the area scale factor of the transformation?
feedback.worked_solution:
The matrix representation of the linear transformation associated with $T$ is $A=[\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 \\ -2 & -3\end{aligned}].$ 

Computing the determinant of $A,$ we get

$$
det(A)=|\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 \\ -2 & -3\end{aligned}|=(-1)\cdot (-3)-(-2)\cdot (-2)=-1.
$$

So, the area scale factor of the transformation is

$$
|det(A)|=|-1|=1.
$$
